1.title: Richelle and Danni
1.caption: Richelle and Danni prepare to spar for the first time
1.fullDescription:
This is the first image onek1995 surprised me with, and because of that I can honestly say it's the one I had the most visceral reaction to. I was instantly in love with it. I'd had artist friends produce images of Richelle in the past, and they know how honored and thrilled I was that they took the time to do that. But this was the first time anyone had captured Richelle and Danni together. The result absolutely blew me away. Not only did he capture what they look like, but he somehow managed to encapsulate who they are as characters. All in a single image. If you know the characters, you can pretty much write the dialog to go along with this. And onek1995 does know my characters. And so, he did write the dialog...

Danni: You ready to go, Granny?

Richelle: I'm standing right here. You'd better bring more than attitude, Miss Danni Fucking Harris.

So, here's the thing... this image pretty accurately depicts a scene from my A Puncher's Chance. That scene represented the very first spar between these two, and it was from a story onek had not yet read at that time. So, how close did he come? Well, here's my version of the dialog...

Richelle: Are you sure about this, Harris? I really don't think you know what you're getting yourself into.

Danni: Would you shut up and put your guard up so I can knock you on your ass, already?

So, basically, the only meaningful difference was that I had Richelle start the exchange instead of Danni. And that pretty much sums up their relationship. It's not a question of whether or not they're antagonizing each other. It's simply a matter of who started it.

At any rate, I thought this image was awesome, and I really couldn't believe onek spent the time and effort to put it together for me. Little did I know it was only the beginning.

2.title: Haunted By The Past
2.caption: Cover art for Haunted By The Past
2.fullDescription:
The image you see here is basically cover art for my Haunted By The Past story. Does it immediately catch your attention? Of course it does! Because what my talented friend did here is much more than just capturing a simple scene.

First, allow me to explain. The moment you see in the image does not exist in exactly this way in the story. Instead, it's a composite of the action that took place in one of the climactic scenes toward the end. A scene that took me nearly twenty paragraphs to pull off. But here, onek1995 has reimagined and reinvented things to capture all of the important details and press them into a single, VERY attention-grabbing image. Maybe other visual artists will tell me this is a common thing, but, to me, it is absolutely amazing!

Now, I'm not going to lay out all the details and symbolism included here. I'll let you experience those the way art is meant to be experienced... individually. But I will say that, after I gave him my initial reaction, he explained some of his thinking as he put this together. I have to admit that I was stunned at the number of things I had felt but didn't specifically notice. He put a lot of thought into this, and there are a lot of little details that went into giving it the right atmosphere.

Of course, most amazing to me is the fact that he did this, at all. As with last time, I had no idea what he was up to. And, as with the last time, I was totally blown away.

3.title: Rampage Sports
3.caption: Emma, Richelle and Danni strike a pose
3.fullDescription:
Here we have yet another fantastic gift from onek1995, and, as usual, it left me with no idea what I was supposed to say. But here goes anyway...

First, a quick explanation of what we have here and how this came to be. Pictured above are three of the main characters from the Rampage Sports universe: my OC Richelle in front, with my quasi-OCs Emma Watson on the left and Danneel Harris on the right (both of whom are loosely based on their real world counterparts).

Most of you know this already, but for those wondering why I have celebrities as characters... well, it's hard to explain. But the gist of it is that I blame these guys because I got my start writing as a member of that league.

Anyway, a while back, Onek gifted me this incredible image.

You can read my explanation of that one there, but let's just say I couldn't get enough of it. From the first moment I saw it, I was stunned at the way he'd captured the relationship between my characters. I was literally amazed.

Months later, I made the decision to move my stories to my own website. I did it strictly because I was tired of fighting the formatting on DA, but, as I went on, it developed into something sort of like a proper website. I put some images in here and there, and I got it in my head I needed a pic to head up the Behind The Scenes section.

Because I'm a little slow, I wasted some time scouring the web for generic gym images. When that didn't do it for me, I started to toy with the idea of taking a generic pic and dressing it up RSI style. That's when it hit me...

Hey, stupid... you already have the perfect pic for this!

And that's how his earlier gift became the header image for the story section of the website.

Of course, I gleefully shared what I'd done with Onek, and he seemed to like it. Except what was perfect to me didn't quite work for him. He wanted to do something that was more designed for the purpose. This is where I'm supposed to say I protested and begged him not to spend his time on me. And I did protest. Kinda. You know, sorta. But, the truth was, if he had another idea in his head, then I wanted to see it.

Besides... he was gonna do it, anyway. Those who know him know that for a fact. And those who don't know him... well, what are you waiting for? Click that link up in the header and go say hi.

Anyway... he went into his dark room (that's what I imagine anyway) and set to work on what he felt was a more appropriate title image. And as you can see above, he nailed it.

4.title: Emma's Focus Training
4.caption: Emma and Richelle work with the focus mitts, while Danni keeps an eye on things
4.fullDescription:
So... what in the world can I say here that I haven't said before?

My good friend onek1995 has struck again, and, in his usual manner, he managed to create something extraordinary and totally surprising.

The scene depicted here ties back to my A Puncher's Chance story. More specifically, it sort of represents what happened in Chapter 4 of that story.

Why 'sort of?'

Because this exact scene doesn't happen anywhere in the story. Instead, it's more of a summation of that entire chapter... and also something of a window into a moment that most definitely could have happened off-screen.

How does he do these things? I honestly don't know. First of all, he doesn't need to do them, at all. Second, he could give me a simple image of Richelle and Danni standing around jawing at each other (Could? No... DID.) and he knows I'd go crazy over it. But no... instead he comes up with this scene that's been percolating in his head based on a story he read over a YEAR ago!

As usual, I don't have any way to accurately say how this made me feel. All I can say is that I consider myself very lucky to count Onek as a friend, and I make an effort to remind myself of that every day.

5.title: Stephanie McMahon
5.caption: The inimitable original, Stephanie McMahon
5.fullDescription:
When onek1995 sends me these gifts, I have a bad habit of sitting on them for a while before I share them with others. Why do I wait? I think it's because I have this idea that I'm going to come up with something momentous to say. But no... it's always the same drivel...

This gift from onek1995 is awesome!

It was such a great surprise!

I can't believe the way he read my mind!

Uhm... I'm actually terrified at the way he can read my mind.

Boring, right? I mean, haven't I already said it all before? Yes, but that doesn't make any of it untrue (especially that last one, but that's a different matter).

Anyway... I decided to skip the speech this time because I have, in fact, said it all before. This image is just more of the same from onek1995. Here he's captured one of my 'lesser' characters who really isn't lesser, at all. Yes, the story mostly focuses on Danni and Richelle. Yes, Emma is hard to ignore (mostly because she's always sticking her nose into things). But Steph is almost ALWAYS there, generally handling the things the others are too busy to focus on. Important things. Like actually TRAINING the fighters. In fact, it's safe to say RSI wouldn't be half of what it is without Steph, and it's about damn time somebody gave her the recognition she deserves!

I've said this before and it's always worth saying again: I feel very lucky to count onek1995 as my friend. I used to try and enumerate the reasons for that, but I'm going to have to surrender on that front. There are just too many to count.

6.title: Richelle Works Out
6.caption: Richelle takes her frustrations out on the heavy bag
6.fullDescription:
This is the first of three scenes done by onek1995 that could have been pulled directly out of my Trying Times story. Not really a big deal, until you realize... though the scenes in question were written at the time he shared these with me, I hadn't even started publishing the story yet. So, I knew what I'd written, but he had no clue.

That's right... OneK is a mind-reader.

He would say that's ridiculous. That the similarities between what he drew and what I wrote were just coincidence. But such coincidences have happened in the past. So, I'll just let you be the judge.

As for the details, the top scene may be the most spot on. Chapter 9 of the story has Richelle in a real bad way after her argument with Danni, and she was taking her frustrations out on the heavy bag. There wasn't any art to the way she was doing it, either. She was just ripping into it, with no regard to form or function. Which is exactly the way Mr. OneK depicted her. I mean, look at that. She's not training for anything. That bag is the enemy, and she's trying to kill it. That face on her is dead on with what I wrote - which is unbelievable since I was the only one who knew what I'd written at the time.

7.title: Richelle Strikes a Pose
7.caption: Richelle in a rare casual moment
7.fullDescription: This is the second of three scenes that onek1995 somehow magically pulled out of a story I had yet to publish at the time he created them. I admit this one is not quite a perfect match, but I still grade it as the most amazing of all because it shows something I'd never really tackled before.  Richelle has been in all kinds of situations in my stories, but I don't do too many casual moments with her.  Apparently, OneK felt that needed to be rectified, so he put this image together for me.  Thing is, he's not the only one who felt it was time for some casual Richelle, seeing as how I'd already written just such a scene in chapter 12.  He even put her at the beach, which is literally mind-blowing.

8.title: Richelle Watches Training
8.caption: Richelle watches some of her younger fighters train
8.fullDescription:
Here's the third of three scenes onek1995 pulled directly out of my head. And yeah... OK. I'll give him this one. Richelle standing on the floor watching a couple of her fighters train is probably not an uncommon event. But after those first two images, I'm still calling it spooky... especially since just such a scene popped up in chapter 17 of that story he hadn't seen yet.

So, there you have it. Incontrovertible evidence that OneK is either psychic, or he's been receiving secret information from aliens.

Which, I suppose, would also mean that I'd been abducted by said aliens and had my mind probed.

So, we're going to go with psychic because no self-respecting alien would waste time on such a fruitless endeavor.

9.title: RSI Fight Kit
9.caption: Danni models the RSI fight kit
9.fullDescription:
Onek1995 strikes again! This one is something he put together in a very short period of time. He sent me an image (which will appear later in the gallery) that featured my Danneel Harris character. I had a lot to say about it, and one of the things I mentioned were the colors he'd chosen for one of the outfits and how they were pretty close to what I imagined the RSI fight kit (that's what MMA organizations call their official 'uniforms') would look like.

Well, not close enough I guess, because he read the words 'fight kit' and the next thing you know, the image above on the left was in my inbox. Like, POOF! Next day, there it was. I kid you not. Full disclosure... he referred to it then as 'not the most polished image.'

I dunno... looks pretty damn good to me.

10.title: RSI Fight Kit: Redhead Edition
10.caption: Another view of Danni in her RSI uniform
10.fullDescription:
This one is a follow-up to Onek's previous image. When I saw that one, I mentioned something to him about how the real Danneel Harris's hair has something of a reddish hue to it. It was absolutely meant as a joke. Anyone who knows me knows that tongue-in-cheek redhead comments are kind of my thing. But did that stop him? Nope. And that's where this second image came from. Danni in the kit, with a little redhead action going on, to boot.

Seriously, I don't know why he does these things. You'd think by now I'd know to watch what I say because you never know when he'll take something and run with it.

But let's be honest... there's no reason for me to be more careful. After all, it's been working out just fine for me, so far.

11.title: Richelle Looks On
11.caption: Richelle looks... happy?
11.fullDescription:
Here we have the image that that I should have posted first because this is the one that started everything. At first glance, it seemed pretty simple. onek1995 put together an updated version of my namesake character. Looking pretty casual, which is just right for her most of the time. But it didn't take long for me to notice there was more to it. Then the questions started to form. She's obviously in the locker room at the RSI facility... but what's with the super-soft look? Why has she got that really relaxed lean going? And that expression... has she ever smiled that much? I mean, who or what is she looking at?

Well, turn the page to find out...

12.title: Richelle and Danni
12.caption: Ahh... now it makes sense
12.fullDescription:
Well, surprise, surprise... it's Danni! No... I suppose that's no surprise, at all. But what did amaze me was the way these images perfectly capture the new Richelle and Danni, who finally made their appearance at the end of my last story. They've been friends for years, and it's no secret they enjoy some alone time so they can torture each other in the cage after the others have gone. But this image reveals all the ways things have changed between them. The smiles... the postures... they're much more than friends now, and - after what was probably WAY too much drama - they're 100% comfortable and happy with the way it's all turned out.

That feeling of familiarity inspired me to put a little dialogue together for the scene. I imagine it would start with Danni sensing Richelle's presence without turning around.

Danni: I have this feeling that you're staring at my ass.

Richelle: That's probably because I am.

Danni: And why are you doing that?

Richelle: Why wouldn't I? It's a nice ass.

Danni: You spend a lot of time staring at women's asses?

Richelle: Not until recently, no.

Danni: Uh-huh. This recent change... do you find yourself staring at many asses, or one in particular?

Richelle: Many.

Danni: Excuse me?

Richelle: It's just science. I have to have a large sample. For comparison purposes.

Danni: I see. And how am I doing?

Richelle: Fabulously.

Danni: That's good to know.

Richelle: In fact, it sort of makes me...

Danni: OK... we should probably save that kind of talk until after we spar.

Richelle: You started it. I was just standing here, minding my own business.

Danni: No, you weren't.

Richelle: No... I wasn't.

See how well it fits? And to think... OneK created these months before I posted the final chapters of the story that really brought them together. It's almost like he knew.

13.title: Richelle and Danni 2
13.caption: Richelle watches Danni limber up for some training
13.fullDescription:
Onek1995 liked his previous image so much, he decided to do another.

What can I say? It works for me.

14.title: Emma Kicks Ass
14.caption: Emma as Black Widow?
14.fullDescription:
So... what madness inspired this madness, you ask?

I'm afraid I'm the one to blame. A while back, the Google news aggregator pulled in an article for me that linked Emma Watson to the upcoming Black Widow movie. That article was then reprinted... well, everywhere. And Google kept bringing me every new version. Literally, the same article, word for word, over and over and over again. And did I mind?

Uhm... nope.

The article said the film's creators were looking for a kick-ass female Bond, and that Emma was their top choice for the role.

That was all it took for me to lose my mind... and when that happens, onek1995 is often the recipient of my most ridiculous ramblings.

Then, of course, he feeds the beast by creating stuff like this.

Since then, there's been a whole of nothing on this front. A couple of weeks of repeatedly reading the same info seems to be all I'm going to get, as I'm fairly certain Emma has no role in the film.

But I'm always going to have this image around to keep my imagination alive.

15.title: Richelle and Her Posse
15.caption: So, Richelle has a posse now?
15.fullDescription:
I had nothing to do with this one. I swear. Apparently, onek1995 was looking for something to render, Halloween was drawing near, and voila! This was created.

But here's the thing... has he ever created an RSI image as cool as this? I really couldn't wait to share it, just to see what the reactions would be.

On top of that, it's got me thinking now... how can I take the RSI characters out of the cage more often, and get them into trouble in other places? I'm not sure I can pivot them into the all-female version of Rio Bravo depicted here, but I'm suddenly thinking there's got to be some way to get them out there fighting for truth, tolerance and justice. Or, at least, kicking ass somewhere other than an octagon.

What do you think? Good idea?

It's also worth pointing out just how close this version of Danni and Emma are to reality. His versions of each model have evolved throughout all the different moments and scenes he's captured. All along the way, he's nailed different features to near perfection, but this... this is where it all comes together. When he first sent this to me, he didn't tell me which characters these were supposed to be. I actually had a brief moment of hesitation when I went to respond. I was going to refer to the character on the right as Emma... but was I sure that's who it was supposed to be? The matter was settled quickly. One extra glance told me I had nothing to worry about. There's no mistaking that face for anyone else. And Danni I was instantly certain about.

So, I don't know what to do with this guy. I mean, in years of trying, this is the most off the wall idea he's ever come up with. And yet, it's still awesome.

16.title: Richelle and Danni - New Year's
16.caption: Richelle and Danni enjoy a private moment on New Year's Eve
16.fullDescription:
So, it appears onek1995 has finally outdone himself. I thought this piece was going to stand forever as his most exceptional. And let's be clear... that one has a distinctive uniqueness that guarantees it will always have its place. But the simplicity and tenderness of this one really struck me in a way I'll probably never be able to express. He's created pieces that made me smile and made me laugh and even inspired me to write little scenes on the spot. But I can't recall ever reacting to any of those the way I did this one. The way my hand instantly covered my mouth as the words, Oh, my god... mumbled from my lips. That was definitely a new experience.

I think I really love this one because it captures what I want these two characters to be. Bringing them together has been a slow (and sometimes painful) process, and I'm not 100% sure I did the best job with it. And yet, onek1995 has pulled the right impression out of the mess I made, which means I guess I didn't do as badly as I thought. This isn't just a moment. It's a moment that captures all that's brought them here. They didn't know when they met where they were headed. Hell... they didn't know if they'd even be able to stand working together. And even when they started to figure out what they had, they didn't seem to know how to make anything of it. Not all that long ago, this would have been an awkward situation, with the two of them (mostly Richelle) stumbling over words and trying to decide how to mark the occasion without rocking the boat. But all of that is history. There is a trust and comfort between them now. An understanding that what seemed so fragile before isn't anymore. The relationship will have to continue to evolve, but there seems little chance that it will dissolve (look at me, waxing poetic). Will there be bumps along the way? Probably. Will they be at each other's throats sometimes? Of course. That's just who they are. But beneath it all, there is a connection no one can break.

He did a second version of this image - which is also fantastic in its own way - but I like this version best. For all the shadows take away, I think they add something more important. A sense of intimacy, for sure. Because you can see enough to know what's going on. But most of all, I get a sense of privacy. They've come a long way (and have often taken the hard road) to get here. So, they don't care who sees them, but they're not putting on a show, either. It's an honest moment that's really theirs and theirs alone.

So, I don't know... I don't think that really covers how I felt when I first saw this, but it gives you the basic idea. To see my characters brought to life this way always amazes me. To see them captured in a way I wasn't sure I'd brought across well just blew me away. But let's face it: that's the kind of thing onek1995 does so well.

17.title: Richelle and Danni - New Year's 2
17.caption: Alternate version of the New Year's image
17.fullDescription: Here's the second version of OneK's New Year's image.  Obviously, which is best is really more of an individual call.  This one is the clearer of the two, which allows the viewer to appreciate quite a few details that really can't be seen in the other one.  For me, top-billing goes to the expression on each of their faces, which go along perfectly with how I see them as characters.  But I'd be remiss not to at least give Danni's dress an 'honorable mention' as the most eye-catching detail.  Good lord, woman!

18.title: Richelle and Danni Spar
18.caption: Richelle and Danni in their natural element
18.fullDescription:
So, here he goes again. Onek1995 with another RSI image out of nowhere, once again featuring my two lead characters. Just a little friendly encounter between them... that's about to go totally wrong?

It's sort of a strange moment to see from two people who supposedly care so deeply for each other, but yeah... this is them, to a T. Plenty of love between them, but not nearly enough to cancel out their competitive spirit. They don't want to do real damage, but each would love to get the best of the other. I even wrote a short sequence once where they rung each other's bell in a spar. Looks to me like it's about to happen again.

BTW, that last right there is exactly why I love onek1995's images so much. Because I just spent a paragraph talking about my characters when I'm supposed to be talking about his image. That's what I'm trying to do here. To give him credit and thank him for the gift. But I always end up going off on a little tangent about the characters. Why? Because the image IS the characters. Not just what they look like, but who they are. Every time. Yes, he's done a few that were intentionally a little crazy. But when he's really trying to capture them, he never misses. And for that, I can't thank him enough.

19.title: Danni's Walkout
19.caption: Danni enters the arena for a fight with Steph and Marcy behind
19.fullDescription:
Yet another gift from onek1995, and this one's got a lot to talk about if you really start to dig into it.

First, let's talk basic appearance. These outfits are perfect, all the way around. Steph and Marcy look good sporting RSI's most excellent color scheme in an appropriately subdued manner that takes no attention away from the fighter entering the ring. The towel on Marcy's next is a fantastic touch, too. Meanwhile, Danni looks terrific in her RSI-colored hooded sweatshirt, while showing just a hint of the RSI Fight Kit Onek put together a few months ago. That girl looks ready for action.

The digging starts when you explore the expressions. Two of these characters are looking very confident... and for good reason, too. Marcy is here to do one job. To make sure her fighter is as ready as possible before each round begins. Battle damage is her specialty, and she knows she's good at it. So yes, she considers Danni a friend and she's probably a little uneasy about seeing that friend marching off to battle. But she knows she's ready and able to do her part, come what may.

Danni's situation is different, yet the same. This is a big fight for her. This scene comes from the later chapters of my Trying Times story, and the opponent Danni is about to face basically beat the hell out of her the last time they met. But things are different at this point in the story. Danni knows she has a lot riding on this, but she also knows she's ready to handle it this time.

And then we have Steph...

Poor Steph. I don't write her THAT serious, do I? But, of course, I know I do. And never is she more serious than in moments like this. I've noted in the past how the responsibility of her role weighs on her. Despite the fact that she knows Danni is ready, she also knows anything can happen in a fight. Has she gotten Danni ready for anything? If things go awry, will she have the right advice to get things back on track? To her, the key to have those answers is focus. To be able to watch and see what the opponent is doing, and to be ready as soon as the break comes. So, yeah... from the minute they leave the locker room until the end of the fight, Steph is 100% all business.

So, Onek will deny this (because artists are finicky. Who knew?), but I think is image is just about perfect. It captures the scene exactly the way I imagined it, right down to the thoughts going through each character's head.

I'm not sure how you could do better than that.

20.title: Richelle and Danni - Independence Day
20.caption: Richelle and Danni take a stroll on the beach on the Fourth of July
20.fullDescription:
Yet another gift from onek1995, and I'm going to try something new and not launch into a dramatic monologue this time. He knows I love these little surprises, and I truly love the way he captures my characters. I deeply appreciate his taking the time to create them, and I love sharing them for others to appreciate, as well.

It's funny... one of the first thoughts that hit me when I saw this is that the fireworks may be the deepest part of the image. Certainly, they can be taken literally because of the holiday. But with Richelle and Danni, there's sort of a symbolic meaning, as well.

21.title: Emily VanCamp
21.caption: Ladies and gentlemen, Emily VanCamp!
21.fullDescription:
Ladies and gentlemen, Emily VanCamp!

One of RSI's most well-known champions gets the onek1995 treatment, and, as usual, he nailed it. Like most of the characters I write, Emily is a combination of what I know about the real EVC and some of the characters she's portrayed on TV and in movies. Friendly, hard-working and humble? That comes from what I've seen of the real Emily. A talented ass-kicker who can be somewhat ruthless when the situation requires it? That's a combination of Agent Sharon Carter from the Captain America films and the oh-so-deliciously-wicked Emily Thorne from Revenge. And OneK has captured both sides of my version perfectly. She seems very at home here in the cage, yet she also looks downright happy to see you. The fact that she might also be happy to kick your ass is not shown directly, but it's sort of hinted at, don't you think?

The fact that I've run out of ways to thank OneK for these gifts should come as no surprise. I love the idea that my characters could inspire someone to create something like this, and I always love the way he brings them to life. I feel a little guilty knowing the kind of time that goes into making these images, but he says he really enjoys putting them together.

So, really... it would be rude of me to try and stop him, wouldn't it?

22.title: Richelle: Face or Heel?
22.caption: OneK asks a question: would Richelle be a face or a heel?
22.fullDescription:
So, yet another wonderful onek1995 surprise showed up in my inbox recently.

I pretty much love everything about this one. I guess that's my typical reaction when he pulls one of these out of his hat, but this one seemed to give me even more to enjoy than usual. The outfit (love that color scheme), her pose and posture, the lighting... it all comes together just right. Richelle looks confident, capable and dangerous. All things I've always tried to bring out in her - with some notable exceptions on the confidence. Though I love them all, I can easily say this is one of my favorite of his renditions of her, all the way around. But it was definitely that expression she's wearing that grabbed me right away. So much so that I almost didn't notice - he dropped her into his James Street Gym facility! I had been looking at it for a while before my eyes finally picked up on the initials on the corner pad. That's when I expanded my focus to include the entire image and went, Hey! Kind of a cool moment.

BTW, if you don't know about the JSG, then head back up to the title and click the artist's name. All will be revealed!

Now, about that expression on Richelle's... the title he gave this image asks a question, and the expression he's crafted for her tells me he already knows what my answer would be. That's a face that's giving away nothing, in a very wouldn't-you-like-to-know fashion. And that's pretty much the only answer I've got. There are a number of ways to turn the question. What kind of fighter was she... face or heel? Well, she didn't fight in that kind of environment. She had no persona to maintain. But the way she fought and the things she did probably add up to provide an answer. I'll leave it to the readers to decide what it is. How does she feel about what kind of fighter she was? Richelle has her own opinion on that, but that look she's giving you says she's not telling.

The other way to look at the question is to think about what kind of character she would choose to be if she was going to be a pro style wrestler. That one I have an answer to... but I'm not telling, either.

Anyway... I guess this is what a great image is supposed to be, right? Awesome to look at AND fun to think about. onek1995 scores here on both counts.

23.title: Richelle: Retribution
23.caption: OneK provides his own answer?
23.fullDescription:
So, onek1995 is back with a follow-up to his previous image. I'm pretty sure it represents the answer to his question about Richelle being a face or a heel. Funny thing, though... I still don't actually know what his answer is. I mean, let's face it... this looks pretty heel-ish. But yet he titled it Retribution. So, maybe our nameless victim did something to deserve what she's getting? Is Richelle just getting her pound of flesh?

Well, I'll go so far as to confirm that's something she would do. She's not one to let things slide when she's been wronged in a fight. But whether or not that's the case here is something I'll leave to each of you.

Either way, it sure is a fun image to look at.

24.title: Happy Thanksgiving 2020
24.caption: A fighting female holiday gathering.
24.fullDescription:
Anything I say here would only detract from this one, so I'll keep it short. This awesome creation by onek1995 brings together his James Street Gym characters and a couple of my Rampage Sports gang in a symbolic little moment. That's JSG owner Allison Steele on the far left and powerhouse Laura O'Brien on the far right (with the fabulous red hair), with Richelle and Danni in-between. Quite a bit of redheaded aura in this one, but I don't think Allison looks too intimidated.

Oh, and let's not overlook the outfit swap. Richelle and Danni are both in JSG-appropriate wrestling gear, while Allison and Laura are decked out in the RSI fight kit.

2020 was a crap year. This is the kind of thing that helps make it right. And that's certainly something to be thankful for.

Oh, and just in case it hasn't been clear in the past... my friendship with Onek is absolutely one of the things I am most thankful for... this year and every year.

25.title: Danni And Richelle: A Discussion
25.caption: A dynamic duo if ever I've seen one.
25.fullDescription:
The talented onek1995 strikes again!

Here we have my Richelle and Danni characters dropped into the JSG setting... and looking like a whole lot of trouble. Confident, conspiratorial... and even a little bit happy? It makes me wish that mirror was a little wider so we could see what poor souls were waiting in the other corner. But that's probably best left to the imagination.

What I love best about Onek's images is the way they get me to think. Here, my first thought was, A conversation between Danni and Richelle? Shouldn't they be in opposite corners, waiting for the bell to ring? That's often the case with them, but this image actually captures their other side. When the banter and the antagonism is over, and it's time to really take action. That's when they stop becoming each other's problem, and instead combine to become one hell of a problem for whoever stands in their way.

Also, the image of them back-to-back like this kind of makes me giddy. So, there's that, too.

26.title: Discussion: RSI Edition
26.caption: Back on home turf.
26.fullDescription:
Here we have the RSI edition of that last image by onek1995. Comparing the two, I gotta say... though there's something about seeing them in their real home here, I think I prefer the JSG look. First of all, those outfits. Good lord, those outfits. But also, I think there's something more subliminally correct about the idea of the two of them teaming up physically in the wrestling ring.

But, hmmm... tag team MMA? I could see that becoming a thing.

Oh, who am I kidding? I'm sure that somewhere out there, it's already a thing.

27.title: The Opposition?
27.caption: Seriously... when will I learn?
27.fullDescription:
So, when I published this gift from onek1995 a few weeks ago, I mentioned that it made me wonder what poor souls were waiting to get their asses kicked in the other corner.

As usual, I had no idea what that would trigger, and now we have OneK's answer. And there's nothing poor about these souls, at all.

In the RSI world, Emma Watson and Emily VanCamp have steadily grown into major characters. Along with Steph McMahon, they make up the big three that Richelle and Danni turn to constantly to help keep the wheels on the RSI bus, so to speak. But this image isn't about their leadership skills. This one's all about in-cage prowess... and suffice it to say that Richelle and Danni are in for a helluva battle. Richelle may have to lean on some of her more questionable underground tactics to pull this one out.

What has brought us to this moment? I can't say for sure, but my best guess is that the ladies haven't taken too kindly to Richelle calling them the 'Em and Em girls'... even though she meant it as something of a compliment.

How do I know this moment would never 'really' happen? Well, first of all, a bad nickname is hardly reason to invoke a 'trial by combat' to settle the matter. But even more telling... I don't think Danni would back Richelle up in this particular situation. After all, she did warn her not to call them that.

The moral of the story? Same as always. It's all fun and games until you say something that triggers Mr. OneK. Then... well, you just never know.

It should come as no surprise that I love this image. I really enjoy making characters out of these women, and trying to bring each one's traits forward in a way fits with the RSI story. Emma and Emily have long been two of my favorites, and it's a thrill to see them brought to life this way.

28.title: Trying Times
28.caption: Cover art for Trying Times
28.fullDescription:
If the 3D fight art thing doesn't work out, I guess onek1995 could fall back to a career as a cover artist.

So, what seems like forever ago, he created this image as the cover to my Haunted by the Past story. You can take a look at everything I said about it then, but suffice to say I really liked it.

But, OH... look how far he's come!

As I said to him when he shared it with me, this new cover for Trying Times is so good, it almost defies analysis. It focuses directly on the core of the story, and does it in a way that's dramatic, eye-catching, and - most importantly - intriguing. You can't look at this and not want to know what it's all about.

There are a couple of things I'd like to point out. First, Richelle's outfit. I gave no clues in the story as to what she was wearing in this scene, so OneK was flying completely solo on this one. And I have to say he really nailed it. Stylish and well thought out, yet magnificently casual. And the leather jacket... there's a story behind that. Some of you may know it, but I'm not going to rehash it here. I'll simply say our artist knew what he was doing when he made that decision.

The other thing... telling you this is probably violating the basic rule of letting viewers interpret a work for themselves, but it's too good for me to let you miss it. Notice the open door? Just about everything in this scene states the obvious. Richelle and Danni have found their way to a very bad place in their relationship. But onek1995 has left that door open as a way of giving the situation a little hope that maybe these two can find a way to work things out.

And no, I didn't figure that out for myself. OneK had to tell what he'd been thinking with that detail. I'm thick that way. But once he pointed it out... like I said, it was too good for me to let anyone miss it.

So, there you have it... another masterpiece by onek1995. It's not just interesting to look at. It's got quite a bit of depth to it, as well.

Now, I have to wonder if my story lives up to its new cover!

29.title: RSI Jog
29.caption: Richelle and Danni putting in the work
29.fullDescription:
Here we have another terrific image that onek1995 dropped on me out of the blue, and I'm going to do something a little different with this one. I'm pretty sure I always say I'm not going to ruin his images by over-analyzing them. This time, I'm actually not going to do it. It's a fun image, featuring Richelle and Danni in a totally realistic moment. Neither will admit it, but they're not spring chickens anymore. Gotta put a little extra into the cardio program if they want to keep up with all the younger fighters joining the group.

My reason for actually following through on keeping the analysis light is that this image really needs to just be appreciated. I'm not 100% how this one came together, but my understanding is it's a blend of a background image and the Daz characters. I'm sure there are many here who can speak to what it takes to make something like this work. All I know is it looks damn good, and, as always, I appreciate the fact that he took the time to put it together.

30.title: Happy Halloween?
30.caption: Danni and Richelle, ready for... something.
30.fullDescription:
Onek1995 strikes again, this time with a holiday twist.

So, onek knows how story-oriented I am, so no doubt he was wondering how I would square this up with the characters involved. I mean, Richelle in a costume? Not even if she was a legit superhero. Danni, on the other hand, would probably be willing to play along with anything she thought would be fun. And when she suggested to Richelle that they do it together, the conversation probably would have gone something like...

Richelle: Not a chance, Harris.

Danni: Oh, c'mon. It'll be fun.

Richelle: Nope. Not me. If you want to do it, be my guest. But I'm out.

Danni: Don't be a pain in the ass. The girls thought this would be fun. They're looking forward to it.

Richelle: That's fine. Tell them I hope they have a great time, but leave me out of it.

It would go on like that periodically until Danni finally got her to relent with something like, Fine! But just make it something simple.

Then Danni would show up with these, and a whole new conversation would get started.

So, how would Richelle finally end up in the costume?

I think by now, the answer to that should be obvious. No one can ever get her to do something she doesn't want to do... except for Danni.

My thanks, as always, to Onek1995. He know how much I enjoy getting his little takes on my characters, and it's always fun to imagine how these scenes would play out, so to speak.

31.title: Old School Richelle
31.caption: Do I really have to explain?
31.fullDescription:
There's a lot of ways to turn and twist this moment that onek1995 has created. Is Richelle on her way to victory? Making a desperate comeback? Enjoying a brief moment of success against an opponent she wasn't ready for? That all falls under the you make the call umbrella.

That said, the basic elements are clear. This is a much younger Richelle, doing her thing in a place no sane person would ever go.

The kicker? Well, it's yet another eerily familiar tale of mind-reading on his part.

I don't know exactly what inspired Mr. Onek to create this image at the particular moment he did, but, unbeknownst to him, I started writing a story about a week before he shared this with me. It was literally in its infancy. So new, it didn't even have a title.

But a subtitle? That it had:

Young Richelle Story Number 1

Seriously... how does he keep doing this?

32.title: Danni And Richelle
32.caption: Danni and Richelle hit the beach again on the Fourth of July
32.fullDescription:
OK, I know I've said this kind of thing before, but I really am going to let this fantastic creation by onek1995 stand alone without a lot of commentary from me.

What I will say is that this is another one of those moments he's captured from his imagination that could easily have been a scene I'd actually written. And, as has happened before, it may well inspire a scene I write down the line.

I also realized this is a new entry in a quickly growing collection of Richelle and Danni holiday scenes.

The rest I'll leave to you. As usual, there were things that struck me right away about this one, and I've shared those thoughts with Onek. But more than anything, this feels like a piece that needs to be left to the eye of the beholder... so, that's exactly what I'm going to do.

33.title: Danni, Richelle and guest
33.caption: A holiday treat
33.fullDescription: What is there to say about this one?  onek1995 was feeling some holiday cheer, and what better way to express that than to bring in a very special guest who needs no introduction?

34.title: The official RSI Hoodie
34.caption: So, we're selling merch, now?
34.fullDescription: Thanks to onek1995, the official RSI hoodie is now a thing.  Or, at least, a thing in progress.  This is something he's been doing on and off, and this image represents the state of things, right now.  I've told him it looks great the way it is, but does he listen?  Nope, and I'll probably be better off for it.

35.title: RSI Hoodie - Back View
35.caption: The view from behind
35.fullDescription: The reverse view of onek1995's RSI hoodie design.

36.title: Richelle Wearin' the Green
36.caption: If you're Irish, step into the parlor...
36.fullDescription: Apparently, onek1995 was looking for a good subject to focus on for St. Patrick's Day, and he thought of Richelle.  I cannot say I'm disappointed that he made this association.
